subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus focused source-level retry coverage as sufficient proof for this non-inducible xAI provider rotation, or require organic after-fix Grok/gateway logs before merge?
rationale: The code change is narrow and source-reproducible, but ClawSweeper cannot independently produce the exact code-less xAI stale-ciphertext error because it depends on provider-side snapshot/key rotation.

options.title: Accept Proof Override
options.body: Treat the pre-fix production logs, existing proven retry path, and positive/negative unit tests as sufficient for this provider-side trigger and apply an explicit proof override before merge.

options.title: Wait For Organic Logs
options.body: Keep the PR open until an organic xAI rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway output showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Request Replacement Proof Shape
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-run synthetic proof that exercises the exact predicate and retry request shape, while acknowledging it cannot prove xAI's live rotation response.

recommendation.title: Accept Proof Override
recommendation.body: Treat the pre-fix production logs, existing proven retry path, and positive/negative unit tests as sufficient for this provider-side trigger and apply an explicit proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the prior same-surface encrypted-reasoning retry behavior and are the strongest history-backed owner for a proof-sufficiency call on this predicate.
